validator.source_text:
<scxml xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2005/07/scxml" version="1.0">
  <state id="a">
    <transition event="go" target="b"/>
  </state>
  <final id="b"/>
</scxml>

diagnostics.message: the `<scxml>` root has several child states but no explicit initial state

primary.message: entry behavior depends on implicit document order

secondary.message: entered first because it comes first in document order

notes: without `initial`, the first of several child states in document order is entered; reordering children silently changes behavior (a single child state is not reported)
diagnostics.help: make the entry explicit with `initial="a"` (keeps the current behavior), or name the state that should be entered first

fixes.message: make the current entry state `a` explicit
